spans.s: तुन् unadi affix तु, added to the roots सि, तन् , गम् etc. See तु (4).

तुन्दादि a very small class of words headed by the word तुन्द to which the taddhita affix इल ( इलच् ) is added in the sense of possession ( मत्वर्थ ). The affix इल is optional and the other affixes इन् , इक and मत् are also added; e.g. तुन्दिल, तुन्दी, तुन्दिकः, तुन्दवान् ; similarly उदरिलः etc.; cf. Kas. on
